name: CEA of insecticide-treated net (ITN) distributions — version 24.2 [grant for DRC 2025-26]
summary: Distributes insecticide-treated bed nets to protect people from malaria in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (2025–26 grant). GiveWell's spreadsheet "CEA of insecticide-treated net (ITN) distributions — version 24.2 [grant for DRC 2025-26]", linked from 2 of its grant pages. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.
